name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-05-12, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
